title: Spec 014 mounted route shared canonical repository readback

phases.objective: Prove that one mounted synthetic Tenant HTTP request executes against one canonical in-memory Control Plane repository and leaves operation, plan, journal, reconciliation, adapter, and Tenant-safe readback evidence bound to the same operation and run without promoting the parent Spec 014 MVP.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The same mounted request completes the same synthetic operation in the same canonical memory repository, consumes its immutable plan with the same run, persists prepared/result/readback journal events and an applied reconciliation, mutates the same synthetic adapter, and returns a Tenant-safe readback bound to that operation and run.
steps: Build one Tenant operation, immutable plan, active lease, authorization, one-shot enablement, canonical memory Control Plane repository, and canonical synthetic adapter.
Resolve Context Kernel and current dynamic authority evidence for the operation.
Submit one authenticated Tenant HTTP request through the mounted storage route.
Execute the authorized synthetic plan using the same repository and adapter supplied to the mounted runtime.
Read the same repository aggregate after the HTTP response and require completed operation state, same-run plan consumption, prepared/result/readback journal phases, and an applied reconciliation.
Read the same adapter after the HTTP response and require the planned item to be absent with one mutation receipt.
Bind the Tenant-safe response operation and run identifiers to the persisted aggregate without exposing paths, authority payloads, credentials, or private evidence.
assertions: One mounted HTTP request and the post-response assertions use the same canonical repository object.
The operation reaches completed state and its immutable plan is consumed by the request run.
Journal phases are exactly prepared, result, and readback for the request operation.
The result journal records deleted and one applied reconciliation is persisted for the request run.
The same canonical synthetic adapter records the item deletion and one mutation receipt.
The Tenant-safe response operation_id and run_id match the persisted aggregate.
The evidence proves shared canonical memory state only; durable SQL state and live provider state remain false.
The parent feature 014-governed-hostinger-storage-orchestration is not promoted.
Provider dispatch, live mutation, migration Apply, deployment, Production readiness, and secrets remain disabled.

phases.objective: Reconstruct the same synthetic aggregate from an exported canonical snapshot and prove request evidence survives a repository restart boundary.
Add bounded fault injection and restart reconciliation for the same mounted operation and run.
Run the separately authorized non-production canary only after the durable SQL and worker authority gates are satisfied.
This synthetic canonical-memory evidence grants no live, provider, migration, deployment, or Production authority.
